author: John Hammond
description:
Could a Windows notification really look like it came from Microsoft Edge?

This proof of concept uses Windows toast notifications, Application User Model IDs, and registry modifications to make a notification appear as though it was sent by Microsoft Edge. It is a good reminder that legitimate Windows features can be abused to carry out convincing phishing and social engineering.

Watch the full video here: https://youtu.be/wrAFZLa1TAk?si=CxyHDhZ_iMSh3Ia1
title: Fake Edge Update
